g           GOTO          go to a document given as a URL
G           ECGOTO        edit the current document's URL and go to it
h           PREV_DOC      return to the previous document
H           HELP          display help on using the browser
j           NEXT_LINK     make the next link current
k           PREV_LINK     make the previous link current
K           KEYMAP        display the current key map
l           ACTIVATE      follow the current link
L           LIST          list references in the current document
